system.description: All party members suffer 1 stress and add 1 recharge counter to a currently recharging action, if able. All party members suffer 1 stress, and add 2 recharge counters to currently recharging actions, if able, then tension resets to zero. Per session, a player may add one {Df} fortune die to any Intelligence Fellowship check equal to the number of fortune points currently in the Entourage fortune pool.
